references.context: Order theory: every decreasing sequence of ideals under inclusion eventually stabilizes

references.disposition: Every chain has its own stabilization index; Artinian does not mean the ring has a finite number of ideals.

review_rationale: Read the descending-chain condition on ideals as the defining Artinian property for a commutative ring. Not the ascending-chain condition for Noetherian rings, and not finite cardinality of R.
